newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA SAYS Q1 PROFIT 269,300 LATS.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA SAYS Q1 PROFIT 269,300 LATS.

text.p: Valmiera Glassfibre factory on Monday said that its first quarter unaudited after-tax profit came to 269,300 lats on net turnover of 2.53 million lats.
This was a fall against profit of some 600,000 lats during the same period of 1996. Turnover was 2.71 million lats in the first quarter of last year, finance director Imant Saulitis told Reuters.
The company earlier said that the smaller profit figure was mainly due to the fall of the mark as more than 50 percent of Valmiera's market is in Germany.
